glitch_catalogue_gates.extract_rule: 'Start time' and 'End time' of every row whose interval overlaps the onset +/- 24 h, copied verbatim in source order (how-we-built-it/code/scripts/extract_spike_subset.py, mode window); only this window is shipped because the package must not carry a copy of a third-party dataset; the same script in mode year regenerates the full scanned-span extract (1971 days 36-365: 9361 MH1 rows, sha256 7ceff7e10c0f28d83a2dd1f84ba56ced5538533d4c66d146549f98e321ac6fa4; 11394 MH2 rows, sha256 f3b6fb225730fd614ab9fc1de4e2592f874027d1e90b17520345fb005aa1f4ce) from the archive
glitch_catalogue_gates.timing: The glitch-catalogue gates G1 and G2 were not part of this claim's original pre-registration: they were pre-registered at the lens level at 2026-11-13T05:59:12Z, after the claim's own three-skeptic panel (run 2026-11-12-2317), with G1 already seen (a post-panel check, run 2026-11-13-0514) and G2 not yet computed at the time of the freeze.

G1.definition: no catalogued S14 MH1 or MH2 ACC-Spike interval [start, end] overlaps [window start, window start + 450 s]

G2.definition: mute +/- 5 s every overlapping catalogued spike and every raw sample with |x - median| > 8 max(MAD, 0.5) in the raw 450 s window (either channel), template and data muted at the same samples; NCC over unmuted samples, best lag within +/- 10 s; pass if best single-channel CC >= 0.6 and D > 0.2868

G3_descriptive.note: fraction with a catalogued S14 MH1/MH2 ACC-Spike in [start - 60 s, start + 450 s], 1971-02-05..1977-09-30 (levent start times are minute-resolution); no gate; NOT reproducible from the shipped files: regenerated from the source archive and levent by how-we-built-it/code/scripts/g3_base_rates.py

descriptive.note: computed after the gates were frozen and known; decides nothing; only the spike count below is reproducible from the shipped files, the rest needs the source archive (RUN_IT_YOURSELF.md)

gap_context.note: stretches of 9.487 h or longer with no S14 MH1/MH2 interval of any type, 1971 days 36-365 (how-we-built-it/code/scripts/daily_counts.py)
